title: TARDIS · Railway Insights
description: TARDIS explores historical SNCF railway data to analyse monthly arrival delays, compare machine learning forecasts and replay a validated route-average baseline through an interactive dashboard.
project_context: Collective EPITECH student project, followed by a reproducibility and dashboard refactor in October 2026.
